share.title: Share referral code
share.guide: Referral codes are issued per listing. Open the listing you want to refer and tap "Share referral code".
share.perListingLead: Refer this listing to someone who needs it. Referral codes are separate for each listing — tapping again on the same listing gives the same code, and
share.freeUnknown: new listings this month are free up to your plan's included count.
share.freeN: {n, plural, one {{n} new listing this month is} other {{n} new listings this month are}} free (free members · one account per verified person).
share.freeNone: free members have no free codes and pay {extra} per code (paid plans include codes up to their plan limit).
share.perListingTail: If they open your referral link and inquire about this listing within 90 days, you are recorded as the referrer.
share.allWithListing: Refer this listing to someone who needs it. If they open your referral link and inquire within 90 days, you are recorded as the referrer.
share.allNoListing: Refer Safe Referral listings to someone who needs them. If they open your referral link and inquire within 90 days, you are recorded as the referrer.
share.loginGet: Log in to get a referral code
share.verifyNoFree: You are not verified yet — referral codes are issued after identity verification (no free codes · {extra} each).
share.verifyFreeN: You are not verified yet — free referral codes ({n} per month) are limited to one account per verified person.
share.verifyFree: You are not verified yet — free referral codes are limited to one account per verified person.
